findings.claim: No test covers the editor's interactions, including search filtering, the 'Reset all overrides' action and its disabled state, a switch toggle calling setOverride, a revert action calling clearOverride, and a section hiding itself when it has no matching rows.

The hook reads only the data from the config query and ignores isLoading and error, so when the config service fails every flag renders as 'Off' with no indication that loading failed, and toggling a flag in that state saves an override based on invalid or missing config.
When a search matches no flags, both sections return null, leaving the area under the search box blank instead of showing a message like other list views in the app do for zero results.

The only test verifying the editor stays out of production builds is skipped unless the RUN_BUNDLE_TESTS environment variable is set, and nothing in the workflows or scripts sets that variable, so a break in the production-exclusion guard would not be caught by CI.
The story titles use the prefix 'FeatureFlags/...' instead of the 'Features/FeatureFlags/...' pattern used by other feature stories and specified in apps/web/AGENTS.md.

The prop tabIndex={isOverridden ? undefined : -1} sits inside a block already gated on isOverridden being true, so the -1 branch can never execute, making the ternary dead code that should be simplified.

The production check process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IS_PRODUCTION === 'true' is written inline in multiple places (also in SafeSidebarContent.tsx) instead of reusing the shared IS_PRODUCTION constant from config/constants.ts, and the sidebar copy has no comment explaining why it needs the inline form.
The feature has no contract.ts, feature.ts, or createFeatureHandle, which docs/feature-architecture.md requires for features, though other features in the codebase also skip this pattern.
The Developer group block is almost a copy of the DeFi group block a few lines above it, duplicating the same structure rather than sharing it.
